WITH behavior_counts AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
), shares AS (
  SELECT tradekind, analysis_count,
         CAST(analysis_count AS REAL) / SUM(analysis_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM behavior_counts
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT s.tradekind, s.analysis_count, s.share,
       s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_average
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
WHERE a.avg_share IS NOT NULL
  AND s.share > a.avg_share;
